# Rewise

> Rewise is a Maltese smart home company. Its product, Rewise Air, is a small puck that makes any air conditioner with an infrared remote smart. Rewise Air is on sale now at https://rewisehome.com/get for €27.99, one payment with no subscription and free delivery in Malta.

## Rewise Air

- What it does: control your AC from your phone from anywhere, with schedules and automations, Siri and Alexa.
- Compatibility: every air conditioner with an infrared remote. It has built-in support for 40+ brands, and it can learn other remotes.
- Your remote keeps working: Rewise Air picks up presses from the original remote, so the app stays in sync.
- Sensor: a built-in sensor reads the room's temperature and humidity.
- Setup: no new AC, no wiring and no electrician. Add it from the Rewise app; it needs USB-C power and Wi-Fi.
- Control: the app sends the exact mode, temperature and fan speed, not just a power toggle. It also works with Siri and Shortcuts, Alexa and Home Assistant.
- Cost: the app shows energy and cost estimates, based on the AC's rated efficiency.
- Apps: the Rewise app for Android is available now, and the iPhone app is coming to the App Store. Home Assistant is also supported.
- Price: €27.99, one payment, no subscription.
- Buying: order online at https://rewisehome.com/get, with secure card payment through Stripe.
- Delivery: free delivery to addresses in Malta.
- Returns: 14-day returns for a full refund and a two-year guarantee.
- Made by: designed in Malta by Rewise.

## Rewise Home

Rewise Home is an optional plan for Rewise Air owners, at €9.99 a month on a 6-month plan. It adds up to 3 more Rewise Air units on loan. Ask about it at https://rewisehome.com/enquire.
